key_insight: ORCHID-SAGE formalizes expert CALPHAD assessment decisions into recorded protocols so thermodynamic databases can be regenerated, not just reused.
engineering_relevance: Reproducible, updatable phase-stability databases could support alloy design and synthesis planning in self-driving laboratories.
method: Encode assessment knowledge and judgments in formal, automatable protocols.
Record database construction from evidence through model assessment.
Test regeneration using a second-machine script, an MCP-only AI agent, and a public-source refit.
evidence_signal: In the initial Cr–Ni demonstration, all three regeneration routes yielded the same predictions, according to the abstract.
watch_item: The demonstration covers one alloy system; broader applicability and reliable capture of expert judgment remain to be established.
paper_title: ORCHID-SAGE: Fully Reproducible CALPHAD Assessment from Evidence to Phase Diagram
